metadata.question: Does the snow cover extent in the Tinguiririca basin (specifically -34.752733, -70.647985) increase in December 18, 2023, compared to December 18, 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location). - Use MODIS daily snow products on the exact dates: Terra (MODIS/061/MOD10A1) and Aqua (MODIS/061/MYD10A1). - Location: Point (-34.752733, -70.647985) buffered to 20 km to represent local basin area. - Dates: 2021-12-18 and 2023-12-18. If both sensors have no image on the exact day, attempt a ±1 day fallback to find the nearest image; otherwise C1. 2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?). - For MODIS NDSI_Snow_Cover, valid range is 0–100. Mask out values outside this as invalid/cloud/no-decision. - Define snow where NDSI_Snow_Cover >= 50 (>=50% snow in pixel). - Compute valid pixel count and snow pixel count at 1 km scale. 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3). - If collection empty after fallback for either date → C1. - If valid pixel count == 0 for either date → C2. - If computed snow percentage is null/NaN or outside [0,100] → C3. - Otherwise compare 2023 vs 2021: if 2023 > 2021 → A, else B. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Helper to evaluate ee.Objects as Promise const ev = (obj) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => { obj.evaluate((res, err) => { if (err) reject(err); else resolve(res); }); }); // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const lon = -70.647985; const lat = -34.752733; const region = ee.Geometry.Point([lon, lat]).buffer({distance: 20000}); // 20 km buffer const dates = ['2021-12-18', '2023-12-18']; async function buildImageForDate(dateStr) { const start = ee.Date(dateStr); const end = start.advance(1, 'day'); const terraCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD10A1').filterDate(start, end); const aquaCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MYD10A1').filterDate(start, end); const terraSize = await ev(terraCol.size()); const aquaSize = await ev(aquaCol.size()); let img = null; let usedInfo = 'Same-day'; if (terraSize === 0 && aquaSize === 0) { // Fallback: ±1 day window, choose nearest image among Terra/Aqua const wStart = start.advance(-1, 'day'); const wEnd = end.advance(1, 'day'); const altCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD10A1') .filterDate(wStart, wEnd) .merge(ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MYD10A1').filterDate(wStart, wEnd)) .map((im) => im.set('diff', im.date().difference(start, 'day').abs())) .sort('diff'); const altSize = await ev(altCol.size()); if (altSize === 0) { return { status: 'C1', terraSize, aquaSize, usedInfo: 'No images ±1d' }; } const nearest = ee.Image(altCol.first()); img = nearest.select('NDSI_Snow_Cover'); const usedDate = await ev(nearest.date().format('YYYY-MM-dd')); usedInfo = `Fallback:${usedDate}`; return { status: 'OK', img, terraSize, aquaSize, usedInfo }; } else { // Combine Terra and Aqua same-day via per-pixel max to reduce cloud gaps let images = []; if (terraSize > 0) images.push(ee.Image(terraCol.first()).select('NDSI_Snow_Cover')); if (aquaSize > 0) images.push(ee.Image(aquaCol.first()).select('NDSI_Snow_Cover')); img = images.length === 2 ? ee.ImageCollection(images).max() : images[0]; return { status: 'OK', img, terraSize, aquaSize, usedInfo }; } } async function computeStats(dateStr) { const built = await buildImageForDate(dateStr); if (built.status !== 'OK') return built; const img = built.img; // Valid range mask (0..100) const validMask = img.gte(0).and(img.lte(100)); const validImg = img.updateMask(validMask).select('NDSI_Snow_Cover'); // Counts at 1 km scale const scale = 1000; const maxPixels = 1e9; // Total possible pixels in region at scale const ones = ee.Image(1).rename('ones'); const totalDict = ones.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPixels }); const totalPossible = (await ev(totalDict)).ones || 0; const validDict = validImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPixels }); const validCount = (await ev(validDict))['NDSI_Snow_Cover'] || 0; if (!totalPossible || validCount === 0) { return { status: validCount === 0 ? 'C2' : 'C3', terraSize: built.terraSize, aquaSize: built.aquaSize, usedInfo: built.usedInfo, totalPossible, validCount }; } // Snow pixels: NDSI_Snow_Cover >= 50 within valid pixels const snowMask = validImg.gte(50); const snowOnes = ee.Image(1).updateMask(snowMask).rename('ones'); const snowDict = snowOnes.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPixels }); const snowCount = (await ev(snowDict)).ones || 0; const snowPct = (snowCount / validCount) * 100.0; const cloudPct = ((totalPossible - validCount) / totalPossible) * 100.0; if ( snowPct === null || isNaN(snowPct) || !isFinite(snowPct) || snowPct < 0 || snowPct > 100 ) { return { status: 'C3', terraSize: built.terraSize, aquaSize: built.aquaSize, usedInfo: built.usedInfo }; } return { status: 'OK', terraSize: built.terraSize, aquaSize: built.aquaSize, usedInfo: built.usedInfo, validCount, snowCount, totalPossible, snowPct, cloudPct }; } try { const s2021 = await computeStats(dates[0]); const s2023 = await computeStats(dates[1]); // Print concise evidence (max 20 lines) if (s2021.status === 'C1' || s2023.status === 'C1') { console.log(`2021 MODIS Terra/Aqua: ${s2021.terraSize || 0}/${s2021.aquaSize || 0}`); console.log(`2023 MODIS Terra/Aqua: ${s2023.terraSize || 0}/${s2023.aquaSize || 0}`); console.log('C1'); return; } if (s2021.status === 'C2' || s2023.status === 'C2') { console.log(`2021 Valid Pixels: ${s2021.validCount || 0}/${s2021.totalPossible || 0}`); console.log(`2023 Valid Pixels: ${s2023.validCount || 0}/${s2023.totalPossible || 0}`); console.log('C2'); return; } if (s2021.status === 'C3' || s2023.status === 'C3') { console.log('C3'); return; } console.log(`2021-12-18 Terra/Aqua imgs: ${s2021.terraSize}/${s2021.aquaSize} (${s2021.usedInfo})`); console.log( `2021 Valid: ${s2021.validCount}, Snow: ${s2021.snowCount}, Snow%: ${s2021.snowPct.toFixed( 2 )}, Invalid%: ${s2021.cloudPct.toFixed(1)}` ); console.log(`2023-12-18 Terra/Aqua imgs: ${s2023.terraSize}/${s2023.aquaSize} (${s2023.usedInfo})`); console.log( `2023 Valid: ${s2023.validCount}, Snow: ${s2023.snowCount}, Snow%: ${s2023.snowPct.toFixed( 2 )}, Invalid%: ${s2023.cloudPct.toFixed(1)}` ); const diff = s2023.snowPct - s2021.snowPct; console.log(`Change (2023-2021): ${diff.toFixed(2)} pp`); // Final decision if (!isFinite(diff)) { console.log('C3'); } else if (diff > 0) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } catch (err) { console.log('D'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
